items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Ethereum’s new DeFi security tool raises questions over censorship
items.summary: Phylax’s system lets decentralized protocols block potentially harmful transactions, but raises questions about potential censorship and Ethereum’s concentrated builder market.

items.title: Hong Kong adds Hyperliquid to list of ‘suspicious’ crypto platforms
items.summary: Hong Kong’s securities regulator said Hyperliquid has no local license and may have promoted its trading services to investors in the city.

items.title: GTA VI publisher racks up nearly 3x Nvidia’s tokenized stock volume
items.summary: Tokenized Take-Two shares drew $249.5 million in DEX volume Wednesday, nearly three times the $88.1 million for tokenized Nvidia shares.

items.title: Sweden’s H100 could tap Bitcoin trading pool to fund share buybacks
items.summary: Shareholders will vote Dec. 7 on whether H100 can buy back up to 10% of its shares, potentially using a Bitcoin pool that lost about 30 BTC in Q3.

items.title: IOSCO warns quantum upgrades could slow blockchains, leave security gaps
items.summary: A Solana test network ran about 90% slower with quantum-resistant signatures, and wallets that keep using older keys could remain vulnerable.

items.title: Gen Z Embraces Crypto While Most Americans Call It a 'Side Quest'
items.summary: A SoFi and YouGov survey found that 21% of Gen Z adults own crypto, more than hold employer retirement plans, even as only 13% of all Americans own it and most remain skeptical.

items.title: Quantum Upgrade Could Be 'Particularly Challenging' for Blockchains: IOSCO
items.summary: The global securities watchdog said markets shouldn't wait for quantum computers to arrive, flagging bulkier signatures and harder upgrades.

items.title: Morning Minute: Google’s Newest AI Model Tops Benchmarks Ahead of Anthropic IPO
items.summary: Anthropic bulls seem to be shrugging off the news, as ANT pops 25% over IPO price on Hyperliquid pre-debut.

items.title: Binance Wins $6.5B Freezing Order Over Hack That Can Be Served via the Blockchain
items.summary: An Abu Dhabi court's worldwide injunction targets the unknown hackers, backed by a "living list" of 26,000 wallets holding stolen funds.

items.title: GameStop CEO Says Digital-Only Games Have ‘Hurt Consumers’ as GTA 6 Skips Discs
items.summary: Ryan Cohen said publishers are cutting out trade-ins, as he backs a U.S. bill that would guarantee gamers keep access to games they buy.

items.title: Bitcoin Struggles to Hold $64,000 as ETF Outflows Hit $2.9B in November
items.summary: Bitcoin is down 13% in a week as investors pull money from spot ETFs and brace for another Federal Reserve rate hike.

items.title: Bitcoin finance protocol Hashi goes live on Sui mainnet
items.summary: Hashi is processing bitcoin deposits on Sui mainnet, with hBTC used for Fluid loans and HoneyB vaults on Upshift.

items.title: US launches cybercrime center with TRM Labs to help trace crypto tied to scams
items.summary: The Threat Disruption Center will help investigators trace victims’ funds and identify crypto wallets used by scammers.

items.title: 1inch integrates Hyperliquid’s perpetual futures contracts into its dApp and wallet platform
items.summary: Users can fund a position with a token they already hold on 1inch, which will be routed to USDC and deposited to a balance on Hyperliquid.

items.title: Ant International launches protocol for real-time settlement between tokenized deposits and money market funds
items.summary: Ant launched the Whale Orchestration Protocol to enable settlement between tokenized deposits and tokenized money market funds.

items.title: Singapore’s MAS issues $77 million in tokenized bills settled via CBDC
items.summary: The central bank said the bills were issued natively on its Singapore Dollar Test Network and settled in wholesale CBDC.

items.title: Sygnum sees bitcoin carry trades beating Treasury bills in 2027 as funding recovers
items.summary: Bitcoin funding stayed negative for 67 consecutive days into May before recovering to about 8% annualized by the end of October.
